action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that GStreamer Base Plugins incorrectly handled certain
OGG media files. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to
execute arbitrary code if it opened a specially crafted file.
isummary:
GStreamer Base Plugins could be made to crash or run programs as your
login if it opened a specially crafted file.
title: GStreamer Base Plugins vulnerability
